The fine print, in plain words
Readings are for entertainment only — not medical, mental-health, financial, legal or relationship advice.
Readings are written by AI on your phone and can be wrong or odd.
We don\'t run background checks or verify anyone. You\'re responsible for your own safety when you chat with or meet people.
You give up some rights to sue us, and US disputes go to individual arbitration (no class actions) unless you opt out within 30 days.
Some rights can\'t be waived where you live; those stay with you.

Nearby Conjunctions
When you\'re within about 50 m of someone compatible who also uses Nearby, you\'ll both get a match card.
While Nearby is on, your phone sends its location to our servers about once a minute. We keep only the latest spot, for 10 minutes. It\'s never shown to anyone.
Matches see your photo, first name, age, signs, relationship status and what you\'re looking for — before either of you accepts.
Swipe right to accept, left to pass. Chat opens only when you both swipe right.
We don\'t verify anyone. Meet in public and read the Safety Tips first.
Pause or turn off any time. Pause at home or work so strangers can\'t place you.
